correctness.rationale: Explicit 15-edge Petersen incidence yields the integral six-dimensional graph H1; the full nodal normalization gluing sequence gives the Picard-torus character lattice. A concrete 6x6 integral U has determinant -2, Smith invariants 1,1,1,1,1,2, and satisfies equivariance for all 120 S5 elements with signed edge permutations. The 72x36 linear intertwiner system generated by a transposition and five-cycle has rank 35 modulo 101. Because U is a nonzero rational solution, the rational rank is exactly 35, hence the rational Hom space is Q·U; U has an entry 1 so integer Hom is Z·U. Character-lattice duality gives a μ2-isogeny, nonreduced in characteristic two. The exact finite certificates were replayed from standalone paths and are conclusive for the finite-group/matrix claims; no finite experiment substitutes for an infinite assertion.

originality.rationale: The full Petersen-boundary geometry, S5 action, rational representation type and general nodal torus formula are established antecedents and not claimed new. The assessed nontrivial refinement is the exact integral S5-intertwiner module, its minimal index-two map and the μ2-descended isogeny. Specialist integral-lattice priority remains a residual risk; non-detection alone is not the originality argument.
residual_risks: A specialist table of integral S5 lattices or older Jacobian literature may already present an equivalent index-two inclusion. No independent literature-priority certification is claimed.
The 2019/2020 Wiman–Edge work includes other integral lattices, but the inspected sections did not identify a comparison to this rank-six graph-cycle lattice.
The isogeny is canonical only up to the sign of the primitive equivariant generator; individual split tori can be abstractly isomorphic.

value.rationale: The ten-line boundary of the quintic del Pezzo and M0,5 is a distinguished, intrinsically defined maximally nodal genus-six curve; its generalized Jacobian controls line-bundle gluing. Determining the entire integral equivariant Hom lattice identifies a genuine two-primary obstruction invisible to rational/complex representation data, and the associated μ2-isogeny has a subtle non-étale kernel in characteristic two. This is an exact natural structural classification across every finite-field twist, not a contrived parameter slice or a small ad hoc numerical improvement.
